rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when revealing hidden information by telling it.

example.english: They finally reveal that there is a problem with the contract.
example.traditional: 佢終於講出嚟，原來份合約有問題。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 gong2 ceot1 lei4 jyun4 loi4 fan6 hap6 joek3 jau5 man6 tai4

rows.note: Choose this when uncovering something physically hidden or figuratively exposing a secret, mystery, or truth.

example.english: We finally reveal the truth behind this mystery.
example.traditional: 我哋終於揭開呢宗懸案背後嘅真相。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 kit3 hoi1 ni1 zung1 jyun4 on3 bui3 hau6 ge3 zan1 soeng3

rows.note: Use this formal verb specifically when a god, spirit, or other supernatural source discloses previously unknowable information.

example.english: Ancient myths say that gods reveal truths unknown to humankind.
example.traditional: 古代神話講，神明會啟示人類未知嘅真理。
example.jyutping: gu2 doi6 san4 waa6 gong2 san4 ming4 wui5 kai2 si6 jan4 leoi6 mei6 zi1 ge3 zan1 lei5
